description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for checking if a given date parameter falls within the start and end dates of a specific timesheet. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Time plugin's API validation rules, ensuring that comments associated with timesheets are correctly date-validated.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentDateParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that ensures a provided date falls within the start and end dates of a specific timesheet identified by its ID.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with the specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input date string is within the timesheet's start and end date range.
